correctness.rationale: The 81-entry seed in certificate.json produces exactly 27 proper vertices and 81 distinct rainbow 4-cycles under independently reconstructed graph adjacency. Matching-count parity forbids 6 colours on every six-regular odd-order triple torus. The coordinatewise mod-3 graph covering preserves local properness and maps all 4-cycles to seed 4-cycles, proving the entire stated infinite family. The bundled standard-library verifier was run and reproduced its recorded output.

originality.rationale: Full primary 2023 article bounds the seed graph at 7..8. Full 2026 v1 paper retains the odd triple exact case under a higher-dimensional conjecture, and its existing repetition lemma alone cannot create the missing 7-colour seed. The exact certificate and its consequent odd three-multiple family are not implied by these statements. Targeted published mathematical-record searches found no equivalent. Independent priority is still unverified.
residual_risks: Independent bibliographic priority has not been established against every possible unpublished or differently indexed seven-colour table.
The general covering/repetition lemma is known; originality depends entirely on the new seed certificate and exact previously unresolved case, not on repeating colours alone.

value.rationale: The exact seven-colour result closes the documented 7-vs-8 gap for the smallest ternary three-torus, a natural 27-vertex graph. The explicit certificate, combined with existing covering theory, yields infinitely many previously unresolved three-dimensional odd-torus instances of Jiang–Li Conjecture 7.1. This is a motivated exact invariant and mathematical construction, not an arbitrary finite enumeration.
